## Cryptomaty vs AlgoTest: Ready-Made Crypto Strategies


Both platforms let you start without having to build a strategy from scratch, but their approaches differ.


**Cryptomaty** offers 80+ strategy templates that you can deploy or customise.


**AlgoTest** offers ready-made strategies through Crypto Bazaar, with a stronger focus on performance review and strategy testing before live deployment.


If you want more templates and customisation, Cryptomaty offers greater choice. If you want to evaluate and validate a strategy before automating it, AlgoTest offers a more structured workflow.

## Which Is Better for Beginners and Automated Crypto Trading?


For beginners, choosing a strategy is only one part of the process. You also need to understand how it has performed, how much risk it carries, and how it behaves in live markets.


With AlgoTest, you can start with a Crypto Bazaar strategy, review its historical results, and forward test it before using real capital.


You can also move beyond ready-made strategies later by building and testing your own BTC or ETH setups.


Cryptomaty is better suited to traders who want to explore and customise a larger number of templates.[AlgoTest](https://algotest.in/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=internal&utm_campaign=seo&utm_content=main-page&utm_term=algotest&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=internal&utm_campaign=seo&utm_term=algotest&utm_content=main-page) is better suited to traders who want to **test before they automate** .

A: Yes. AlgoTest supports crypto strategy backtesting, allowing you to check how a strategy would have performed historically before live deployment.


Q: What is the difference between Cryptomaty and AlgoTest?


A: Cryptomaty focuses heavily on ready-made templates, visual strategy building, and AI-assisted opportunity discovery. AlgoTest combines ready-made strategies through Crypto Bazaar with backtesting, forward testing, and live automated crypto trading.

A: Cryptomaty offers a larger template library, while AlgoTest focuses on giving traders a structured way to review, test, forward test, and automate crypto strategies. The better choice depends on whether you value template variety or a test-before-deployment workflow.
